Hi Neha,

We are working through the SIG/CAIQ review for Acme's procurement team and need to collect evidence related to personnel security and onboarding/offboarding controls. Could you please provide the following by EOD Monday (2026-08-17 PT):

- LMS training completion roster for security awareness and data handling (last 12 months) — CSV export preferred.

- Signed attestation (DocuSign or PDF) from HR/Security confirming the above processes are in effect.
